_note: Live audit settings (docs/LIVE_AUDIT.md, Divit 2026-10-09). rendered_fields: spec fields that must appear on the rendered page exactly once (may_repeat: allowed more than once by the template). auto_fields: fields the audit may change on its own. deterministic_codes: Layer A codes whose fix code can compute (ops/live_audit.py live-fix apply); other P0/P1 issues in auto_fields go to a writer agent; the rest are proposed.
stray_patterns: This is some text inside of a div block
_note_held: held_hosts: every page held in status/ship/*.json is checked on each of these on every run; HTTP 200 anywhere = P0 A0-held-live, unpublish at once (Divit 2026-10-09).
_note_verify_launch_console_ignore: verify_launch_console_ignore: used only by ops/verify_launch.mjs, which runs page scripts in jsdom (no real browser, no error source): jsdom gaps and the site's own known noise. Not used by the live audit or the staging check: Divit 2026-10-15 dropped the text list there; they apply only console_ignore_sources (source or element based).
_note_console_ignore_sources: console_ignore_sources (Divit 2026-10-14, widened 2026-10-15; narrow, named exceptions): a console error or page error is ignored only when (a) its SOURCE (the reporting script URL or the top stack frame, captured through CDP by ops/console_capture.mjs) matches `src`, and, where given, some stack frame matches `stack_any`: Microsoft Clarity's clarity.js (any version), the Bing UET automatic Clarity loader (www.clarity.ms/tag/uet/..., source of the "reading 'unshift'" page error; counts as the Clarity exception, 2026-10-15), the Clarity loader GTM injects (its www.clarity.ms/tag/ script, or GTM's inline code with a clarity.ms frame in the stack) Clarity's collect beacon https://c.clarity.ms/c.gif when the request fails or the host is unreachable (kind log, that URL as the source; 2026-10-15, counts as the Clarity exception; `kind` restricts a source entry to one kind of error) and Adwire's molecule.js; or (b) for an `element` entry, the page document itself reported it (kind log, no script in the stack) and the capture tied it to the element matching every `element` field: the navbar <svg width="2o"> on the /ai-contests dropdown icon in KS's shared navbar component (2026-10-15, until KS fixes it; each document is tied on its own load, so the first load is matched as well as the load-more ?xxxx_page=2 document; an svg width error from any other element, or the same text from a script, still fails). Never matched on message text. The exceptions in force and every ignored error are printed on every run (ops/console_filter.py). ops/staging_check.py and ops/live_audit.py apply only this list; any other console error fails. REMOVED 2026-10-26 (A, Divit go): the navbar <svg width="2o"> element exception; KS fixed it to width="20" (checked on /ai-form-builder/consent, /ai-landing-page-builder/thank-you-page, /ai-survey-and-quiz-builder/nps; GitHub audit run #19 had 0 A9-console). Any svg width error now fails again.
_note_social_ok: social_ok: A7-link treats these statuses from these domains (and their subdomains) as OK: social sites rate-limit or bot-block the audit (429; LinkedIn answers bots with 999) but serve people (Divit 2026-10-12). Any other status from them (404, 410, 5xx) is still a finding; a 429 from any other domain is still a finding.
faq_schema: info-only: FAQ schema on child templates is not needed (DECISIONS 2026-10-06); a schema that exists must match the visible FAQ
